column1: # Scope of every original asm file for tools/progress.py (hand-maintained; generated once on 2026-10-13 from
# tools/re/T1-TRIAGE.tsv, the deleted PORTING-STATUS.md table and the F1 split). scope: logic = faithful port (D2),
# ui = rewrite in Bevy incl. sound (D3/D8, not counted as logic), sdk = X3, out = D9/X1/X2. share = fraction of the
# file's labelled functions that are logic to port (1 for pure logic files; <1 for mixed files, from T1 in:/out: counts
# or the F1 split); fns = `*_func_start` labels when generated (progress.py recounts); ghidra_fns = functions Ghidra found in
# the file's address range (battle + field decompile sets, 2026-10-13; 0 = not decompiled): the denominator uses
# max(fns, ghidra_fns) x share, because `.byte`-encoded code (800+ battle handlers) has no asm labels. Edit this file to re-baseline.
